p: Dropdown component for displaying and selecting recent folders
Sets the current folder for the dropdown, updating its displayed name based on the folder path.

ul.li: folderPath (string): The full path of the folder to set as the current folder. If the path is invalid or empty, a default folder name will be displayed.
